title: Game-ready and export
summary: High/low pairs, triangle budgets, LODs, material slots, baking setup and export.

request.brief: Submit a prop as a high and low pair, named the way you bake them, with your bake cage if you use one and any LODs you'd make. Leave your export-ready low poly exactly as you'd export it.
must_include: The high poly and the low poly of the same prop
LODs and a cage if you make them
The low poly's materials and UVs as exported

questions.ask: What triangle budget do you give a hero prop and a background prop?
